content: pandas DataFrame, 2032 rows: geochemistry of Chilean mine-tailings deposits (columns Region, Faena, Deposito, IDQ, Coord. E/N, oxides and trace elements incl. REE)
origin: Public geochemical registry of tailings deposits in Chile (SERNAGEOMIN); preprocessed pickle from the TGPY project
note: The pickle is not committed. Whether the derived CSV is committed (public repository) is the author's decision.

derived_subset.made_by: data/relaves/export_csv.py (Region == COQUIMBO, positive coordinates; identifiers, UTM coordinates, 5 REE targets, 5 host-mineral covariates)
derived_subset.equivalence: figures/make_figure_data.py builds an identical prepared table from this CSV and from the pickle (checked 2026-11-06, DataFrame.equals)
derived_subset.read_order: the pipeline reads this CSV when present, else the pickle
